note: Two domains writing the same canonical key is not a collision and is not counted as one: fourteen domains describe a shared corpus of 20,210 mantras. Only a shared property with divergent values, or a duplicated minted identity, is a collision.

collisions.subject: VG:AV:SAU:K06:S056:V002
collisions.resolution: 'scope_type' is used by unrelated domain families (attribution, audio) and almost certainly means different things in each. Namespace it per domain at import; do NOT resolve by precedence, which would overwrite one concept with another
